'''2004 World Championship Day 2/3 Brandon Schele DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Schele]] at [[2004 World Championship]] (Day 2/3), finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brandon "Jedi Genius" Schele (2004-08-23).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33542 World Champion DS: KTOD Senate is BACK]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040914015144/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33542 Internet Archive]</ref>
